item.tib: dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu skor las gsol 'debs man shel phreng ba
item.coloph: ces dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i nang sgrub gab pa dgu skor gyi gsol 'debs man shel phreng ba 'di yang / spyang bla rin po che tshul khrims dbang grags dang rigs mthun grogs po tshul khrims blo gros lhan nas bskul ba la brten nas/ rgod rje'i rus gsang ba'i ming ni 7g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des/ kun 'thob (thob) tshe dbang bde che snying po 'am/ bzang bde chen pho brang du sbyar ba'o//
